name: sdlc
description: Full Claude Code SDLC pipeline with 24 skills: a 12-stage map-architecture to ship backbone, a 5-skill design line (design-system, ux-flows, prepare-design-spec, screens, verify-ui) that goes from a 3-5 sentence user story to screens with every state, a PNG per state from any design tool with an MCP (pen.dev, Figma, others; one design-keeper agent reconciles the component library in each) or markdown wireframes in code mode and a live browser check, interview ideation (feature and greenfield project modes with an easy/medium/hard depth regulator), a scaffold skill that materializes a new project from the base-tpl template with subtractive batteries, and other cross-cutting utilities including user-documentation for end-user docs generated from a live app (playwright-cli walks, per-flow doc-flow subagents, screenshots and optional screencast replays). Per-feature artifacts live under docs/features/<slug>/, the design canon under docs/design/; skills own their templates and end with explicit stage handoffs.
